Abilities.Name: Expert Repair Crews
Abilities.Effect: At the start of the Repair step of the End Phase, remove all Crippling effects from a friendly Group.

Abilities.Name: Duct Tape and Bubblegum
Abilities.Effect: When a friendly Ship of M, H, or C tonnage is destroyed by damage from an opponent's attack (including any Crippling or Explosion Effects), it remains in play until the start of the End Phase. At the start of the End Phase, roll for explosion and remove that Ship from play. That Ship counts as destroyed.

Abilities.Name: Redundant Ship Systems
Abilities.Effect: When you would roll for Crippling Effects for a friendly Ship (for any reason), after rolling, you may pay up to 3AP. Add or subtract 1 (to a minimum of 2) from the result of the roll for each AP paid this way

Abilities.Name: Big Guns a' Blazing
Abilities.Effect: When you assign a Group's Weapon System with Damage 2 or higher to targets, double the Attack value of that Weapon System and that Weapon System has an unmodifiable Lock Value of 4+ and only causes criticals on a 6+ for this attack and cannot have its dice rolls modified in any way. If this Ability affects a Weapon System with an Arc of B, it costs an additional 1AP. If this Ability affects a Weapon System on a Ship of H or C Tonnage, this Ability costs an additional 1AP (additional costs are cumulative).

Abilities.Name: Never Tell Me The Odds
Abilities.Effect: When you move a Group through Scenery you may re-roll any Kinetic or Energy saves for that movement. When you move/place a Wing through Scenery, you may re-roll the dice when rolling to remove those Assets.

Abilities.Name: Missile Storm
Abilities.Effect: At the start of a friendly Group's activation, choose a Weapon System with "Missile" in its name. That Weapon System gains Fusillade-2 and Anti-Wing until the end of the Activation."

Abilities.Name: Subsystem Network
Abilities.Effect: Before you attack with a Group of M tonnage, pick two of its weapon systems with the same name without the Linked-X special rule. Those weapons gain Linked-SSN for that attack.

Abilities.Name: Manic Repairs
Abilities.Effect: When you activate a Group, all ships in that group gain Regenerate-2 until the end of the round.

Abilities.Name: Resistance Elite Force
Abilities.Effect: At the end of the round, remove 2D3 enemy Battalions from a friendly ship.

Special: When this Load is shared with Bulk Landers, 2 Launch are needed to place 1 Fire Ship.

LaunchAssets.Target: Cities. Ships and Space stations in the same Orbital Layer.
